correctness.evidence: Independent read-off of all listed tables reproduced the reported regularity/projective-dimension pairs. The complete H-plus-edge table was independently recovered from the H table by the standard disjoint-edge product relation, including the one-step regularity increase. The remaining finite tables retain their committed exact homology and Euler/Hilbert certificates.

originality.evidence: Checked prior work covers forests/cycles, selected circulant families, structural classifications, and general regularity bounds, not these seven exact finite tables. The elementary H-plus-edge relation itself is excluded from the novelty claim.

scientific_value.evidence: The seven exact tables are reusable benchmark data for edge-ideal computations and tests of standard invariant bounds.

residual_risks: The campaign cross-check did not rerun every exact homology computation for G1-G5; those tables retain the committed replayable certificate.
Originality is restricted to the explicit finite table collection.
decision: PASS on all three axes under the finite benchmark interpretation.
